asset_conventions.description: This registry is git-tracked metadata only. Store small reference images under codex-skills/video-master-pipeline/digital-humans/<id>/ when needed. Large driving plates belong under digital-humans/<id>/plates/ or existing production asset directories and must remain gitignored.
asset_conventions.large_file_policy: Do not copy large MP4/WAV/M4A assets into codex-skills. Reference accepted existing production paths or ignored local asset folders.
